{{Quote|Get this&mdash;if you take the node address tinyf posted this from and track the databit history, you pull right to the node that the original data came from&mdash;it's a thaereian node, tee-aitch-dot-ex-one-dot-one-dot-three-dot-eight (thought I'd spell it out since your pathetic synapses don't seem to be able to fire in sequence long enough to follow even the simple bits of data history tinyf left for us&mdash;and if you didn't already know that "th" is the prefix for all the thaereian nodes, well, I just can't help you).|myrlinator, posting on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref>}}
'''Databit history''' was a record that showed the origin of a message submitted via a [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]] node. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Tiny.f]] shared on the [[Cularin holonet node]] what was purported to be a decrypted message sent by [[Jir Tramsig]]&mdash;<ref name="destabilization" />the commander of [[Thaereian military]] forces in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;<ref name="Over Thaere">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004b_thaere&c=swlfc|text=Over Thaere}}</ref> to [[Thaereian]] [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] that highlighted a Thaereian plot to promote social and economic disruption in the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]]. By tracing the databit history of the post back to its point of origination, at Thaereian holonet node th.x1.1.3.8, the slicer [[myrlinator]] verified Tiny.f's claim that the communique originated from a Thaereian source.<ref name="destabilization" />

Sometime later, an intercepted message was shared on the Cularin holonet note that many users interpreted to be a report discussing the [[Almas Academy]], a [[Jedi academy]]<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref> that operated on the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>. The slicer [[alyssa]]roxu scrutinized the message and could find no databit history supporting its legitimacy.<ref name="academic review" />
